questions.question: In his song about the LORD being his light and salvation, what question does David ask?
What was the one thing David asked of the LORD?

answers.text: To dwell in the LORD's house all his days
To see every one of his enemies defeated
To live a long and peaceful life in his land

questions.question: In the day of trouble, what did David say the LORD would do for him?

answers.text: Send an army to fight for him
Bring down fire on his enemies

questions.question: What command did David end his song of trust in the LORD with?

answers.text: Lift your hands to the LORD
Go out and fight for the LORD
